mapper.select: SELECT e.source_turn_id AS turnId, e.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM memory_project_entries e LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = e.project_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.source_turn_id IN #{tid} UNION ALL SELECT e.source_turn_input_id AS turnId, e.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM memory_project_entries e LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = e.project_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.source_turn_input_id IS NOT NULL AND e.source_turn_input_id IN #{tid}

SELECT DISTINCT a.file_id AS fileId, e.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM memory_asset_memories a JOIN memory_project_entries e ON e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.content_type = 'FILE' AND e.file_id = a.file_id JOIN memory_project_members m ON m.project_id = e.project_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = e.project_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.file_id, e.project_id
